resolved.explanation: Willison (s05) compares himself with 'somebody who's never written a line of code', while every trial the script then sets against him compares developers (or computing students) by experience; none included non-programmers. 'Both say experience multiplies what the tool gives you' folds his claim into the one the trials test, so s24's 'nothing shows AI multiplying experts far more than novices' reads as a rebuttal of Willison that the evidence cannot give.
resolved.suggestion: Separate the two: say Willison's comparison is with someone who has never coded, which none of these trials included, and that the claim they can test is the first one, whether the best engineers gain more than the rest. Or drop s05.
